name: Search & Web
description: Tools to search the web and social media platforms and read web pages.
progressive_guidance: Prefer hosted.searchWeb for ordinary web searches when the active LLM provider is OpenAI, Anthropic, DeepSeek, OpenRouter, Z.AI, or Kimi (moonshotai). It reuses that provider and API key. Use Grok for X/social searches, when explicitly requested, or when hosted search is unavailable for the active provider/model. For reading a known URL, prefer hosted.fetchUrl with supported active providers. Otherwise use browser_use to navigate and read the page; do not route fetches to Grok unless explicitly requested. DeepSeek native search does not imply native fetch support; use browser_use to read URLs with DeepSeek.
